title: AutoIndexer: Flexible-Order Decoding by Training Causal Models on Chains of Edits
abstract: arXiv:2610.12545v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive decoding is less suited to non-causally ordered data, e.g., cross-references or future dependencies, since their outputs cannot be revised post hoc, unlike iterative human reasoning. Diffusion LLMs partially mitigate this limitation but still cannot flexibly insert or remove arbitrary numbers of tokens from a pre-generated context. We design AutoIndexer as a generative model with a novel training and decoding mechanism that simulates a Chain of Edits, allowing the model to flexibly modify its prior outputs in hindsight via token insertions, substitutions, and deletions. The model learns to predict marker tokens for opening and closing edits, simultaneously moving a cursor to positions in the existing token sequence, analogous to a text editor. translated_title: AutoIndexer：通过在编辑链上训练因果模型实现灵活顺序解码
translated_abstract: 自回归解码不太适合非因果顺序的数据，例如交叉引用或未来依赖关系，因为其输出无法事后修改，这与迭代式的人类推理不同。扩散式大语言模型部分缓解了这一限制，但仍无法灵活地在预先生成的上下文中插入或删除任意数量的标记。我们将AutoIndexer设计为一个具有新颖训练和解码机制的生成模型，该机制模拟“编辑链”，使模型能够通过标记的插入、替换和删除来灵活地事后修改其先前的输出。该模型学习预测用于开启和关闭编辑的标记token，同时将光标移动到现有token序列中的位置，类似于文本编辑器。训练序列是通过对真实标签施加逆链式编辑操作进行扰动而获得的，模型通过撤销这些逆操作来学习编辑。扰动过程……
tldr: AutoIndexer提出了一种模拟文本编辑器的“编辑链”训练与解码机制，使因果自回归模型能够通过插入、替换和删除操作灵活地事后修改已生成的输出，从而支持非因果顺序的灵活解码。
en_tdlr: AutoIndexer introduces a novel Chain-of-Edits training and decoding mechanism that enables causal autoregressive models to flexibly revise prior outputs via insertions, substitutions, and deletions—like a text editor—thereby supporting flexible-order decoding for non-causally ordered data.
